title: Integer domination roots and three-move subtraction games: two notes with verifiers
description: Two short notes with complete proofs and verifiers. (1) -10 is a domination root of a connected graph; the integer domination roots in [-11,-1] are exactly -2,-4,-6,-8,-10; roots -4,-6,-8,-10 occur together in one connected graph with any prescribed multiplicities. (2) Manabe's Conjecture 52 on purely periodic three-move subtraction games holds for all b <= 2a, and for all b <= 250 with any c (computer-assisted). Each verifier recomputes its paper's computer-assisted claims from the definitions. AI systems were used to help find the constructions and proofs and to run the computations. The author verified all arguments and computations and takes full responsibility for all content.
